A log reach is measured by token overlap (>= 4 shared tokens, the module's own _tokens) between a gap and a log entry: heuristic, and labeled so on the record; it is what lets the intention's 'wrong intent' clause (gaps only history settles) be counted. CC's call, per Akien 2026-10-09

A log reach is one per gap: the log entry with the most shared tokens (ties to the lowest index), recorded as {gap_step, gap_kind, log_index, kind (the entry's kind), overlap}; the gap's words are its step plus its assumption and would_settle texts; the entry's words are json.dumps of the whole line.
